items.title: OpenAI frontier models and Codex are now available on AWS
items.summary: OpenAI announced that frontier models and Codex are available through AWS, expanding enterprise access for model deployment and coding workflows.

items.title: Work with Codex from anywhere
items.summary: OpenAI described Codex updates that let users manage longer-running coding agent tasks from mobile and remote environments.

items.title: Advancing voice intelligence with new models in the API
items.summary: OpenAI released new voice models and API capabilities for realtime speech experiences, including improved conversational application support.

items.title: A new personal finance experience in ChatGPT
items.summary: OpenAI introduced a ChatGPT personal finance experience with tools for financial education, planning, and user-facing assistance.

items.title: Anthropic acquires Stainless
items.summary: Anthropic announced the acquisition of Stainless to strengthen SDK, CLI, and MCP server tooling around Claude agent connectivity.

items.title: PwC is deploying Claude to build technology, execute deals, and reinvent enterprise functions for clients
items.summary: Anthropic and PwC expanded their alliance around Claude Code, Claude for Financial Services, and enterprise AI adoption.

items.title: The Gemini app becomes more agentic, delivering proactive, 24/7 help
items.summary: Google announced Gemini app updates that emphasize agentic assistance, personalization, and deeper task support.

items.title: I/O 2026 developer highlights: Antigravity, Gemini API, AI Studio
items.summary: Google summarized developer updates across Gemini API, agent tooling, development platforms, and AI-assisted software workflows.

items.title: Gemini Intelligence brings proactive AI to Android
items.summary: Google introduced Android experiences that use Gemini intelligence across user-facing mobile features and productivity workflows.

items.title: Introducing Muse Spark: Meta's Most Powerful Model Yet
items.summary: Meta introduced Muse Spark, a generative AI tool for creative advertising and media application workflows.

items.title: Apple unveils new accessibility features, and updates powered by Apple Intelligence
items.summary: Apple previewed accessibility features that use Apple Intelligence for VoiceOver, Magnifier, Voice Control, and related user-facing experiences.

items.title: Meta partners with AWS on Graviton chips to power agentic AI
items.summary: Meta announced work with AWS around Graviton chips and compute infrastructure for large-scale AI workloads.

items.title: AI factories: The new infrastructure of intelligence
items.summary: NVIDIA described AI factory infrastructure, Blackwell Ultra systems, and GPU-driven deployment patterns for industrial AI workloads.
